svg.title: l27sen / binary alter ego
svg.desc: Lahsen wearing glasses, abstracted into binary particles that flow into a shaded 27. Cybersecurity engineering student focused on reverse engineering and binary analysis. Hobbies include XOR and PRNG checks, heap use-after-free and GOT overwrites, JWT algorithm confusion, and local LLMs. Advanced CTF practice on Hack The Box and Root-Me.
svg.text: Learn by reversing. Prove by building.
